memory.all_f32_resident_assessment: Logical byte arithmetic fit the preflight MemAvailable snapshot, but an all-resident allocation was intentionally not attempted on the live development host. Its actual RSS and stability are unconfirmed.
memory.implemented_decision: Use layer streaming. The measured strict-FP32 runner remains about 0.50 GiB RSS rather than materializing roughly 55.02 GiB of reconstructed weights.

correctness_validation.runner_open_validation: Every canonical weight/scale payload and every bound BF16 package payload was hash-verified and finite-scanned before forward execution.
small_analytic_tests: [128,128] scale-boundary matvec: rows 0 and 128 produce 130 and 388
BF16 streamed matvec: rows produce 17 and 39

existing_cpu_projection_cross_check.result: Within the existing projection comparison thresholds. It is a semantic cross-check only; the F64 projection path is not the v0.2 primary reference.

unconfirmed: A separate source-model or other independent full-40-layer numerical oracle comparison was not available and was not substituted for the artifact-FP32 reference.
Full frozen-corpus and M=128 checkpoint capture correctness is unconfirmed because that capture was not run.

determinism_pilot.case: raw-p0001, initial token 1, 9 sequential forwards (prompt plus 8 generated teacher-forcing steps)
determinism_pilot.result: All 9 logits hashes, final-hidden hashes, and 40 layer-hidden hashes per step were byte-identical between r1/r2 and between final-binary r3/r4. The r3 summaries also match r1 exactly.

extrapolation.basis: Direct multiplication of the isolated position-0 8.742120321-second forward. It excludes longer-context causal-attention growth and is therefore optimistic, not a measured full-corpus duration.
extrapolation.decision: The literal requested 7 x 4096 workload is a multi-day direct estimate. The frozen primary decode alone is roughly ten optimistic hours; prompt, boundary, and M=128 coverage bring the current sequential-runner estimate back to roughly three optimistic days. Full capture was therefore not started.

capture.created: raw-p0001 position 0 plus 8 generated sequential positions, twice
capture.contents_per_captured_forward: F32 little-endian logits, final hidden, all 40 post-layer residual hidden vectors, and metadata with content hashes
capture.not_created: The 7-stream / 4096-position frozen primary corpus, boundary cases, and M=128 checkpoint corpus
capture.v0_2_qualification_status: not_qualified; no frozen threshold or JSON was changed
